column4: Visit note | 2026-05-04 04:00 PM | Dr. Mahbuba Rahman, Psychiatry | Patient: Puja Paul, 62, female. This is a follow-up visit regarding ongoing low energy and poor sleep. Mrs. Paul, who works as a hotel receptionist, reports that her symptoms began after losing a job in Badda. She states she feels overwhelmed during the evenings and struggles to stay asleep throughout the night. She has Essential hypertension. She denies any new somatic complaints but reports persistent fatigue. On examination: PHQ-9 score 15, BP 147/92 mmHg, pulse 76 bpm, weight 73 kg. The patient denies thoughts of self-harm, and a safety plan with the emergency number 999 was discussed. Assessment: Depressive episode. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to keep a daily routine, walk outdoors daily, start counselling sessions, and call 999 or come to the clinic at once if thoughts of self-harm appear. Follow-up in 2 weeks.
